scorecard.finding: EPS Rs 11.80 on PAT Rs 11.86 cr and NAV Rs 24.74 on net worth Rs 24.87 cr both imply about 1.005 crore pre-issue shares; post-issue P/E 18.25x at Rs 158 reconciles on 1.370 crore shares.

Operating cash flow not available. Total assets rose to Rs 47.55 cr (Mar-26) and borrowings to Rs 16.73 cr while PAT was Rs 11.86 cr, so part of profit is being reinvested in plant and working capital.
Tax split not available; PAT is 78% of EBITDA, which suggests a concessional tax rate or material other income - to be checked in the RHP.
Related-party transactions not available. The company was incorporated in Sep-2022; whether it took over an earlier promoter business (and on what terms) is not known without the RHP.

Objects Rs 42.80 cr (machinery and lab equipment 18.00 + building 6.50 + debt repayment 4.30 + working capital 14.00) over 36.48 lakh fresh shares = Rs 125 a share after 6% assumed expenses, below the Rs 150 floor.
Customer and geographic concentration not available; the company says it exports to 50+ countries. A single plant at Waghodia GIDC, Vadodara.
Contingent liabilities and litigation not available.
Auditor and any qualifications not available.
Fresh issue Rs 57.64 cr: monitoring agency mandatory above Rs 50 cr; to be named in the RHP.
SME eligibility: incorporated Sep-2022, so the operating track record is short; not re-computed from the RHP.
JDA Capital Services (sole BRLM): track record not compiled. One tracker names Religo Capital Advisors (DRHP stage).

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY26 PAT by +0.0%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 26.8x reported and 26.8x adjusted.
checked: PAT is 78% of EBITDA in FY26, high for a 25% tax rate: either a concessional tax regime or material other income - not testable without the RHP
4M FY27 margins (EBITDA 36.11%, PAT 25.70%) are well below FY26 (51.58%, 40.28%); the FY26 P/E may flatter recurring earnings
Cash tax, capitalised costs, exceptional items and related-party pricing could not be tested
